author: N6rL
content:
## Result

VaultProjection implemented in alcanzai-core/src/vault_projection.rs.

**VaultConfig**: vault_root + note_subdir (None → Notes/). notes_dir() and watermark_path() helpers.

**VaultProjection** (unit struct, derives Default):
- render_note(ko) → String — public, deterministic, no external calls. YAML frontmatter (alcanzai_id, title, authors block-seq, year, content_type, doi, arxiv_id, source_plugin, fetched_at). Body: # Title, author byline, ## Abstract, ## Content (filtered+sorted blocks), ## Enrichments (json code blocks + flags).
- render() — reads .alcanzai-render-time watermark, re-renders updated_at > watermark only.
- rebuild() — deletes .md files + watermark, then render_since(0) for full regeneration.

**Helpers**: yaml_dquote_escape (backslash/quote/control chars), format_author_byline (1/2/3/4+ patterns), render_blocks (sort by sequence, skip Abstract/PageNumber/RunningHeader/Reference), render_block (Heading→##, ListItem→bullet, FigureCaption/TableCaption→italics, Footnote→footnote).

**error.rs**: Added ProjectionError::LibraryAccess(String) to bridge LibraryError in projection context.

**Cargo.toml**: Added tempfile = "3" dev-dependency.

Tests: 7 vault tests (frontmatter keys, body sections, YAML escaping, doi/arxiv absent when None, abstract absent when None, empty-library rebuild, idempotency). All 33 tests pass (22 unit + 11 membrane). cargo fmt ✓ cargo clippy -D warnings ✓ (zero warnings).

#18 (vault regenerate binary + §6 integration test) is now unblocked.
